cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook reports more” and ends with “users than other drivers”?
cards.back: The handbook reports more traffic-violation arrests among marijuana users than other drivers.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook says a first” and ends with “also bring other criminal penalties”?
cards.back: The handbook says a first drug-impaired-driving conviction may also bring other criminal penalties.
cards.memory_hook: Check readiness before driving.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Ask a doctor about” and ends with “may prevent safe driving”?
cards.back: Ask a doctor about a health condition that may prevent safe driving.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Strong emotions can disrupt” and ends with “information processing while driving”?
cards.back: Strong emotions can disrupt thinking, attention and information processing while driving.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Strong worry, excitement, fear,” and ends with “may prevent safe driving”?
cards.back: Strong worry, excitement, fear, anger or depression may prevent safe driving.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “If angry or excited,” and ends with “until you calm down”?
cards.back: If angry or excited, stay off the road until you calm down.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A short walk or nap” and ends with “excited person settle before driving”?
cards.back: A short walk or nap can help an angry or excited person settle before driving.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “When worried or upset, keep” and ends with “rather than the upsetting issue”?
cards.back: When worried or upset, keep attention on driving rather than the upsetting issue.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Some drivers find radio listening” and ends with “distract them from safe driving”?
cards.back: Some drivers find radio listening helpful when worried or upset, provided it does not distract them from safe driving.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An impatient driver should” and ends with “time and leave earlier”?
cards.back: An impatient driver should allow extra trip time and leave earlier.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not dart through traffic” and ends with “traffic flow because of impatience”?
cards.back: Do not dart through traffic or drive faster than the traffic flow because of impatience.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Having another person drive is” and ends with “emotions interfere with safe driving”?
cards.back: Having another person drive is an option when emotions interfere with safe driving.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Emotions can” and ends with “while driving”?
cards.back: Emotions can increase risk-taking while driving.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.
